name: orders events, ignores exact duplicates, and adds independent participant sessions
closes open sessions only when a current time is provided
input: one completed session, one unfinished session, and an unmatched leave

name: tracks live room populations with stable ranking
input: joins, duplicate joins, leaves, and tied room sizes
test:
tracker = LiveRoomTracker()
tracker.process_event('create', 'beta', 'a', 100)
tracker.process_event('join', 'beta', 'b', 110)
tracker.process_event('create', 'alpha', 'c', 120)
tracker.process_event('join', 'alpha', 'd', 130)
tracker.process_event('join', 'alpha', 'd', 131)
assert tracker.get_top_k(5) == [('alpha', 2), ('beta', 2)]
tracker.process_event('leave', 'alpha', 'd', 140)
tracker.process_event('leave', 'missing', 'nobody', 150)
assert tracker.get_top_k(1) == [('beta', 2)]
tracker.process_event('leave', 'beta', 'a', 160)
tracker.process_event('leave', 'beta', 'b', 170)
assert tracker.get_top_k(5) == [('alpha', 1)]
assert tracker.get_top_k(0) == []
